resumen: Registro personal de actividades, avances y metas. Aquí comparto en qué estoy trabajando actualmente.
entrada: This is Kaye from Freelancer Enterprise. Do you love cooking and trying new dishes? What if you could get paid for it? We are looking for freelancers to prepare a local dish from your country, capture photos of the ingredients and cooking process, and upload them to our client's platform. You will earn money for every successful, approved submission!s
